description: This Java class defines a Spring configuration for generating a JWT secret key using the io.jsonwebtoken library. It injects JwtConfig to obtain the secret key string and creates a SecretKey bean with HMAC SHA.

classes.name: JwtSecretKey
classes.description: A Spring configuration class that provides a SecretKey bean for JWT signing.

methods.name: secretKey
methods.description: Creates and returns a SecretKey for JWT signing, based on a secret key string from JwtConfig.
